title: RF-DETR-N vs RT-DETR-R18: benchmark on COCO
dek: RF-DETR-N leads by 1.6 mAP points at 384 px, but RT-DETR-R18 at 640 px is faster on desktop and every GPU runtime measured.
author: Vision Analysis

blocks.text: RF-DETR-N is the more accurate model, 51.4 vs 49.8 mAP@50-95 against RT-DETR-R18 on an RTX 5070 Ti in PyTorch. The resolutions differ: RF-DETR-N runs at 384 px and RT-DETR-R18 at 640 px, each at its author default, so read this as a deployment comparison, not a matched-input one. RT-DETR-R18 is faster on desktop, 47.2 vs 39.5 FPS, and on every GPU runtime. The order flips on Raspberry Pi 5, where RF-DETR-N runs 2.1 vs 0.8 FPS.

RF-DETR-N (30.47M parameters) and RT-DETR-R18 (20.18M) both ship under Apache-2.0 and evaluate on COCO val2017. They run at different input sizes: RF-DETR-N at 384 px, RT-DETR-R18 at 640 px, each at the author default. Both have verified rows on desktop GPU, Jetson Orin, and Raspberry Pi 5.

blocks.caption: Accuracy vs parameters on COCO val2017. RF-DETR-N and RT-DETR-R18 highlighted against the full set.

blocks.text: mAP is shown in percent form. RF-DETR-N measures 51.4 mAP@50-95 to RT-DETR-R18's 49.8, a 1.6 point lead. The picture reverses on small objects: RT-DETR-R18 leads 32.7 vs 27.7 mAP_small, a 15.38% relative gap.

In PyTorch on the RTX 5070 Ti, RT-DETR-R18 runs 47.2 FPS to RF-DETR-N's 39.5, and its lead grows under conversion: 120.6 vs 67.6 FPS on TensorRT FP32, 113.4 vs 58.3 on TensorRT FP16, 92.5 vs 65.7 on ONNX Runtime. On Jetson Orin both hold 10.2 FPS.
One target breaks the pattern. On Raspberry Pi 5, RF-DETR-N runs 2.1 FPS to RT-DETR-R18's 0.8, the single device where the desktop order does not hold.

Pick RT-DETR-R18 for desktop or GPU deployment, where it is faster on every runtime measured and stronger on small objects. Pick RF-DETR-N for CPU-bound edge targets like the Raspberry Pi 5, or when the higher overall mAP at 384 px matters and VRAM is tight, 151 vs 169 MB. Both ship under Apache-2.0.

# pip install libreyolo
from libreyolo import LibreYOLO

rfdetr = LibreYOLO("LibreRFDETRn.pt")    # 30.47M params, 51.4 mAP@50-95
rtdetr = LibreYOLO("LibreRTDETRr18.pt")  # 20.18M params, 49.8 mAP@50-95

results = rfdetr("image.jpg")
